text: Doctor Louis Creed moves his family from Chicago to [a rural Maine house beside a dangerous highway|trigger|making a new home], and their neighbour Jud Crandall shows them the pet cemetery in the woods. When the family cat is killed, Jud leads Louis beyond it to an ancient Mi'kmaq burial ground, and [the cat comes back|threat|the dead that rise], reeking and vicious. The ghost of a dying jogger warns Louis [not to cross the barrier|rules|break the rule and pay], but when his small son Gage dies on the same road, [grief|wrong|loss that won't heal] pulls him back toward that ground.
